items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Used to be along with Mr. Pritchett and them?

ctx.x: I didn't know him too well, but I know Mr. John Porter is a player. He was. This other old man used to be with the Tonic Tribe, used to play a nice bass tuba too. And that's the same man you're talking about. Used to be along with Mr. Pritchett and them?
